description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-21 when road-to-security-fixes-carried-to-the-merge added a Composer audit section to this skill, which brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover building and maintaining a Composer library: versioning, Laravel integration, autoloading, publishing, a German release phrasing. Near-misses are neighbours on the same packages: a security advisory for a dependency (the /audit command), upgrading every dependency (dependency-upgrade), and an npm package (js-library-packaging). Counterexamples guard 'package' in a shipping and a document sense.

queries.q: release a new version of our Composer package with the fixed autoloader
set up PSR-4 autoloading for this library and add a service provider for Laravel
how do we publish this package to our private Satis registry?
bump the library to 2.0 and write the breaking changes into the changelog
unser Composer-Paket braucht eine neue Version — kümmer dich um Tag und Changelog
composer audit reports a CVE in guzzlehttp/guzzle — fix it
queries.note: a security finding for a dependency → the /audit command and dependency-upgrade's security-fix procedure

queries.q: upgrade all our dependencies to their latest versions
queries.note: upgrading what the project consumes → dependency-upgrade

queries.q: publish our TypeScript utils as an npm package
queries.note: an npm library, not Composer → js-library-packaging

queries.q: package the order and ship it to the customer
what is in the release package for the board meeting?
queries.note: a document bundle, not a code package
